launch_destination.title: Rocket can reach the orbit
launch_destination.fixHint: Choose a rocket with capacity to {destination}.

launch_capacity.title: Launch mass
launch_capacity.fail: Spacecraft is {totalKg} kg but the {vehicle} carries only {capKg} kg to {destination}.
launch_capacity.fixHint: Remove mass or choose a bigger rocket.

bus_mass.title: Bus strength
bus_mass.fail: {totalKg} kg is more than the {busName} can hold ({busMaxKg} kg).
bus_mass.warn: {totalKg} kg is close to the {busName} limit of {busMaxKg} kg.
bus_mass.fixHint: Choose a bigger bus or lighten the spacecraft.

bus_slots.title: Instrument slots
bus_slots.fail: {instrCount} instruments but the {busName} has only {slots} slots.
bus_slots.fixHint: Remove an instrument or choose a bigger bus.

power_balance.title: Power balance
power_balance.fail: Arrays give {genW} W but the spacecraft needs {loadW} W.
power_balance.warn: Only {powerMargin}% power margin ({genW} W vs {loadW} W).
power_balance.fixHint: Add solar watts or remove power-hungry parts.

battery_eclipse.title: Battery for eclipse
battery_eclipse.fail: {batteryWh} Wh is far below the {batteryReqWh} Wh needed for a {eclipseMin}-minute eclipse.
battery_eclipse.warn: {batteryWh} Wh is below the {batteryReqWh} Wh needed for a {eclipseMin}-minute eclipse.
battery_eclipse.pass: {batteryWh} Wh covers the {eclipseMin}-minute eclipse ({batteryReqWh} Wh needed).

deltav_capability.title: Delta-v
deltav_capability.fail: The spacecraft can produce {dvCapability} m/s but needs {insertionDv} m/s just to enter orbit.
deltav_capability.warn: {dvCapability} m/s of {dvRequired} m/s needed: the mission will be cut short.
deltav_capability.fixHint: Raise the delta-v margin or use a higher-Isp engine.

electric_power.title: Electric propulsion power
electric_power.fail: Electric thrusters need at least 1000 W of solar power at this orbit.
electric_power.fixHint: Increase solar array watts or use chemical propulsion.

adcs_environment.title: Attitude control works here
adcs_environment.fail: The {adcsName} needs Earth's magnetic field, which {orbit} does not have.

pointing_quality.title: Pointing accuracy
pointing_quality.warn: Blurred instruments: {blurredList}. Your ADCS holds {adcsDeg} deg.
pointing_quality.pass: All instruments get the pointing they need.
pointing_quality.fixHint: Use a more precise attitude control system.

hga_pointing.title: High-gain antenna pointing
hga_pointing.warn: The dish needs 0.1 deg pointing but {adcsName} holds {adcsDeg} deg, so it adds no gain.
hga_pointing.pass: The high-gain antenna is pointed well (or not used).
hga_pointing.fixHint: Use reaction wheels or remove the dish.

radio_range.title: Radio range
radio_range.fixHint: Choose a different radio or ground network.

data_return.title: Data return
data_return.fail: Only {returnPct}% of the data reaches Earth ({downlink} of {generated} Gbit/day).
data_return.warn: {returnPct}% of the data reaches Earth ({downlink} of {generated} Gbit/day).
data_return.fixHint: Faster radio, high-gain antenna, bigger ground network or compression.

storage.title: Onboard storage
storage.warn: Unsent data will fill the {storage} Gbit storage in a few days.
storage.fixHint: Improve the downlink or use a computer with more storage.

budget_total.title: Total budget
budget_total.fail: The mission costs {totalCost} against a budget of {budget}.
budget_total.fixHint: Cut cost: cheaper rocket, fewer instruments, shorter mission.

role_allocation.title: Role allocation
role_allocation.fixHint: Request funds from a teammate or spend less.

launch_window.title: Launch window
launch_window.pass: Launch at month {launchMonth}, within the {window}-month window.
launch_window.fixHint: Use instruments with shorter development or fewer advanced parts.

required_instruments.title: Required instruments
required_instruments.pass: All required instrument types are on board.
required_instruments.fixHint: Add an instrument of the missing type.

orbit_fit.title: Orbit fits the mission
orbit_fit.fail: {orbit} cannot do this mission. {recommendedOrbit} suits it best.
orbit_fit.warn: {orbit} works at {fit}% effectiveness. {recommendedOrbit} suits it best.

lifetime_min.title: Mission lifetime
lifetime_min.warn: {lifetime} years is shorter than the required {minLifetime} years.

debris_disposal.title: Space debris rule
debris_disposal.warn: The spacecraft cannot deorbit at end of life. Carry {disposalDv} m/s for disposal.
debris_disposal.fixHint: Add propulsion and enough delta-v margin.

natural_lifetime.title: Orbit decay
natural_lifetime.warn: Without propulsion the orbit decays after about {naturalLife} years.
natural_lifetime.fixHint: Add propulsion or shorten the mission.
